items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: I seen Sushan get on the television one day... This man never was a musician in my days.

ctx.x: No, he never acknowledged nothing. He's supposed to help that German man along. in the jazz history. They were going to put down on a moving picture, take names and places of jazz history. And all you can get out of them people is the music come from Africa. It's like I seen Sushan get on the television one day. I'm sitting right in this kitchen here. and he says, I went all the way to the wires of Africa. endangered my health, he says, to get the rhythm. And he says, of course, I could play many other jazz…
